text:
morgan: Heads-up — CI started failing on the poetry lock regen after the tokenizers CVE patch. Failing across linux/mac runners; wheel builds timeout and fallback to sdist causing timeouts. Can we prioritize a hotpatch?

alex: paste logs?

morgan: ```
ERROR: Failed building wheel for tokenizers
  ERROR: Command errored out with exit status 1:
    ...
  RuntimeError: wheel build exceeded timeout (900s)
```

security-bot: CVE-2025-XXXXX tokenizers path-handling flaw marked HIGH. Assigned to eng-security. See ticket SSEC-534. :rotating_light:

sara: We should bump tokenizers to 0.15.2 (upstream fixes) and regen poetry.lock. Transformers might need a min bump too. Problem: manylinux wheels for the new tokenizers release aren't present in our mac/linux caches so CI falling back to sdist.

jia: Note: private deployment artifact signing uses our KMS key alias redwood/artifact-sign. If we rebuild vendor artifacts or produce signed wheels we must rotate or reauthorize the signing key usage. RBAC: only release-admins + infra-admins can Sign in KMS.

alex: Proposed mitigation: hotpatch branch that updates tokenizers + transformers, regen poetry.lock inside manylinux2014 container, and enable wheel cache in CI. Also need a temporary RBAC exception to push to release branch for the PR author.

morgan: Agree. Also propose CI tweaks: increase sdist timeout to 20m for builds triggered by regen, and add a dedicated manylinux wheel cache step.

sara: Tagging @jia — can you own KMS/permission step? We need both the KMS sign perms and an audit log entry for the operation.

jia: Plan: 1) Create hotfix branch hotfix/tokenizers-cve-2025 2) Bump tokenizers to 0.15.2, set transformers >=4.35 3) Regen poetry.lock in docker: quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_x86_64 with pip 23.2 4) Build and sign internal artifacts using KMS alias redwood/artifact-sign 5) Temporarily add alex to release-admins for a 2h window to push hotfix PR and merge 6) Run canary on a small Dedicated pool and monitor latency/errors 7) Backport to 1.x after smoke passes. I'll open the RBAC change with a 2h expiry and attach audit steps.

alex: I'll open the PR now: "hotfix/tokenizers-cve-0.15.2-poetry-lock". CI env var needed: ENABLE_WHEEL_CACHE=true. Also will include the sdist timeout bump in the CI matrix.

deploy-bot: pipeline 1842 failed on wheel build: Timeout after 900s. Retrying with ENABLE_WHEEL_CACHE=true...

morgan: Decision: proceed with hotpatch. Marking P0 for hosted + dedicated. Private deployments get scheduled backport. Security to add note to incident log and SLO watch.

security-bot: CVE review recorded: https://jira.redwood/projects/SSEC/issues/SSEC-534 — remediation plan attached.

sara: After merge: tag release, publish signed artifacts to our internal wheel index, bump infra config to use new wheel-index URL for private deploys, and raise a one-hour maintenance window if needed for private canary.

morgan: I'll create the PR and ping #eng-sre for the canary window this morning (8-10am). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
